schema.name: project_id
schema.label: Project Id
schema.description: One row per project. The project this water monitoring configuration belongs to.

schema.name: provider
schema.label: Provider
schema.description: Data source for turbidity readings: 'hydrovu' (fixed-site) or 'wqdatalive' (NexSens, tidal sites). Defaults to 'hydrovu'.

schema.name: timezone
schema.label: Timezone
schema.description: IANA timezone the reporting window (window_start/window_end) is expressed in. Defaults to 'America/New_York'.

schema.name: window_start
schema.label: Window Start
schema.description: Local time-of-day (HH:MM:SS) the daily reporting window opens. Defaults to '06:00:00'.

schema.name: window_end
schema.label: Window End
schema.description: Local time-of-day (HH:MM:SS) the daily reporting window closes. Defaults to '18:00:00'.

schema.name: interval_minutes
schema.label: Interval (minutes)
schema.description: Expected spacing between readings, in minutes. Defaults to 15.

schema.name: locations
schema.label: Monitor Locations
schema.description: Array of monitor locations: {role, label, hydrovu_location_id?, wqdatalive_device_id?, wqdatalive_device_name?, display_coords}. role is 'background'|'early_warning'|'compliance'|'upstream'|'downstream' -- the FUNCTIONAL role for fixed-site providers (HydroVu), or the PHYSICAL position for tidal sites (WQData LIVE) where the functional role is instead assigned per tide phase at report time.

schema.name: thresholds
schema.label: Thresholds
schema.description: Turbidity limit lines. Absolute/x-background style: {early_warning_ntu?, compliance_4hr_ntu?, compliance_1hr_ntu?, background_multiplier?}. Background-relative style (Penobscot TLC): {early_warning_delta_ntu?, compliance_delta_ntu?} -- when either delta is set the chart renders in 'delta mode' (line = background + delta) and skips the absolute/x-background lines.

schema.name: mode
schema.label: Mode
schema.description: 'background' = baseline collection only (monitor series, no criterion lines or exceedance). 'compliance' = criterion lines + exceedance, plus the tide-aware background/compliance switch on tidal sites. Defaults to 'compliance'.

schema.name: aerial_path
schema.label: Aerial Image Path
schema.description: Annotated aerial site map showing monitor positions. Null = no aerial block on the page.

schema.name: active
schema.label: Active
schema.description: Whether the Water Quality tab is shown for this project. This row's existence with active = true is the tab visibility gate -- a missing row, or one with active = false, hides the tab entirely and skips the Water Quality PDF page.
